name: Immaginification
summary: You know those doodles we used to draw in our school notebooks? Immaginification is exactly that, a 2D platformer created by TheEagle Games. You take control of a stickman and have to run and time your jumps perfectly to get past increasingly difficult platforms without falling into the void. The concept is super simple but can get pretty challenging. Aside from the main ten-level campaign, you can play survival minigames or challenge a friend on the same screen in the arena mode, where the goal is to jump on your opponent. It's a genuine and straightforward project, perfect for anyone looking for an old-school challenge on a literal digital piece of paper.
